import os
import requests

def normalize_expense(payload, config=None):
    config = config or {}
    api_key = config.get("api_key") or os.environ["MINDEE_API_KEY"]
    account_name = config.get("account_name") or os.environ.get("MINDEE_ACCOUNT_NAME")
    if account_name:
        url = f"https://{account_name}.mindee.net/v1/products/mindee/expense_receipts/v5/predict"
    else:
        url = "https://api.mindee.net/v1/products/mindee/expense_receipts/v5/predict"

    headers = {"Authorization": f"Token {api_key}"}
    files = {}

    if isinstance(payload, (bytes, bytearray)):
        files["document"] = ("document.bin", payload)
    elif isinstance(payload, str):
        if payload.startswith("http://") or payload.startswith("https://"):
            headers["Content-Type"] = "application/json"
            response = requests.post(url, headers=headers, json={"document": {"document_url": payload}}, timeout=120)
            response.raise_for_status()
            data = response.json()
            prediction = data.get("document", {}).get("inference", {}).get("prediction", {})
            return {
                "vendor_name": prediction.get("supplier_name", {}).get("value"),
                "invoice_number": prediction.get("invoice_number", {}).get("value"),
                "date": prediction.get("date", {}).get("value"),
                "currency": prediction.get("locale", {}).get("currency"),
                "subtotal": prediction.get("total_net", {}).get("value"),
                "tax": prediction.get("total_tax", {}).get("value"),
                "total": prediction.get("total_amount", {}).get("value"),
                "category": prediction.get("category", {}).get("value"),
                "payment_method": prediction.get("payment_details", {}).get("value"),
                "document_type": "expense_receipt",
                "raw": prediction,
            }
        else:
            files["document"] = (os.path.basename(payload) or "document", open(payload, "rb"))
    elif hasattr(payload, "read"):
        files["document"] = (getattr(payload, "name", "document"), payload)
    else:
        raise TypeError("payload must be bytes, file path, URL, or file-like object")

    try:
        result = requests.post(url, headers=headers, files=files, timeout=120)
    finally:
        if isinstance(payload, str) and not (payload.startswith("http://") or payload.startswith("https://")) and "document" in files:
            file_obj = files["document"][1]
            if hasattr(file_obj, "close"):
                file_obj.close()

    result.raise_for_status()
    data = result.json()
    prediction = data.get("document", {}).get("inference", {}).get("prediction", {})
    result = {
        "vendor_name": prediction.get("supplier_name", {}).get("value"),
        "invoice_number": prediction.get("invoice_number", {}).get("value"),
        "date": prediction.get("date", {}).get("value"),
        "currency": prediction.get("locale", {}).get("currency"),
        "subtotal": prediction.get("total_net", {}).get("value"),
        "tax": prediction.get("total_tax", {}).get("value"),
        "total": prediction.get("total_amount", {}).get("value"),
        "category": prediction.get("category", {}).get("value"),
        "payment_method": prediction.get("payment_details", {}).get("value"),
        "document_type": "expense_receipt",
        "raw": prediction,
    }
    return result
